notes.title: Last Hope Public Roadmap - See our plans for Last Hope.
notes.content:
Last Hope Public Roadmap
Welcome to the Last Hope Public Roadmap! We're thrilled to share our journey toward making Last Hope the ultimate 5v5 PvP FPS experience. Your feedback and support mean the world to us. Please note that timelines are dynamic and subject to change as we refine and enhance the game.
Quarter 1, 2024: Alpha Testing and Core Gameplay    January 4th - February 1st: Alpha Playtest on Steam                    Dive into the intense 5v5 action and provide essential feedback on core gameplay mechanics.            Evaluate map layouts and identify potential balance adjustments.            Quarter 2, 2024: Tactical Gameplay Refinement    March - April: Operator Abilities Overhaul                    Refine and balance unique operator abilities based on Alpha Playtest feedback.            Introduce new tactical gadgets and strategies.                May - June: Map Overhaul and Expansion                    Revise existing maps based on player feedback and improve navigation.            Introduce a new map to diversify tactical options.            Quarter 3, 2024: Immersive Experience Enhancement    July: Visual and Audio Atmosphere Upgrade                    Enhance graphics for better clarity and visual appeal.            Introduce immersive audio enhancements for heightened situational awareness.                August: Weapon and Equipment Customization                    Introduce a robust weapon customization system.            Add new weapons and equipment options to diversify player loadouts.            Quarter 4, 2024: Competitive Features and Pre-Launch Prep    September - October: Ranked Mode Beta                    Implement and test the competitive ranked mode.            Gather feedback on matchmaking, ranking systems, and competitive balance.                November: eSports Integration and Feature Freeze                    Lay the groundwork for eSports integration and partnerships.            Complete feature implementation and shift focus to polishing and optimizing for launch.            Beyond 2024: Post-Launch Support and Expansions    Ongoing: Post-Launch Tournaments and Balance Updates                    Host regular tournaments and events to keep the competitive scene vibrant.            Continuously update and balance the game based on community feedback.                Exploration: Seasonal Expansions and Community-Driven Content                    Introduce seasonal expansions with new maps, operators, and game modes.            Encourage community involvement in map design and content creation.

notes.title: Exciting News! Last Hope Development Resumes - Alpha on Steam Announced
notes.content:
Dear Last Hope Community,

We're overjoyed to share a significant update on the development of Last Hope. After a brief hiatus, we're back on track and thrilled to announce the resumption of development. Your patience and continued support have been crucial, and we're excited to showcase the progress we've made.

Development Resumes: A Renewed Commitment

During the pause, our team has diligently addressed challenges, refining and enhancing every aspect of Last Hope to meet and exceed your expectations. We appreciate your understanding and are eager to bring you an even more compelling gaming experience.

Alpha Playtest on Steam: Be Among the First to Dive In

To involve you directly in the development process, we're excited to announce the Alpha Playtest phase for Last Hope, hosted on Steam. This is a unique opportunity for you to explore the game firsthand, provide feedback, and play a key role in shaping the final product.

Alpha Playtest Schedule: January 4th - February 1st, 2024

Save the date! The Last Hope Alpha Playtest on Steam will kick off on January 4th, 2024, and run until February 1st, 2024. Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of Last Hope and be an essential part of the journey.

 How to Join the Steam Alpha Playtest

Participating in the Last Hope Alpha Playtest on Steam is easy:

Visit our Steam page: Go to our official Last Hope page on Steam.

Join the Playtest: Look for the "Join Playtest" button on the Steam page. Click it to enlist as a playtester for Last Hope.

Receive Access: Once you've joined the playtest, you'll receive instructions on accessing the game during the Alpha Playtest phase.

Expressing Our Gratitude

Thank you for your enduring support. Your enthusiasm fuels our determination to deliver a game that exceeds expectations. As we embark on this exciting phase, we're eager to share the Last Hope experience with you.

Stay tuned for further details and instructions. Let's make Last Hope an extraordinary adventure together.

Best regards,

Dectre Games
